Name: Lazy Tech - Stardew Multi Tool
Author: Anyu9457
Description:
Lazy Tech (懒人科技) is an all-in-one convenience mod for Stardew Valley 1.6 that helps you skip the daily grind.

MAIN FEATURES
- Auto watering & fertilizing (9 fertilizer tiers, 0-9)
- 3-mode crow control (off / pet repels crows / no crows spawn at all)
- Auto-pet animals & pets, auto-fill pet bowls
- Auto-talk to NPCs & auto-accept quests
- Expanded recycling machine (9 new categories)
- One-key gifting from chests (LeftShift + G)
- XP sharing across skills
- Auto eat & drink when low
- Instant tool & building upgrades
- Self-service shops: buy anytime, even when the owner is away or it's their day off
- All-year ice cream stand
- Shop expansion across 16 stores with sensible prices

CONFIG
- F8 opens the in-game pixel-style settings panel (7 tabs)
- Optional Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) support, synced with the F8 panel

REQUIREMENTS
- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI 4.0+

INSTALLATION
Unzip into your Mods folder. SMAPI loads it automatically. See README.md (bilingual) for details.

Shout outs: thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community!
